title.zh: 所得税（高效污染控制设备）规则
title.en: Income Tax (Efficient Pollution Control Equipment) Rules

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Rules may be cited as the Income Tax (Efficient Pollution Control Equipment) Rules.

heading.en: Criteria for efficient pollution control equipment

text.en: 2. Any equipment or device installed for the purposes of preventing, controlling or reducing air pollution or water pollution which satisfies the criteria set out in the Schedule shall be deemed to be an efficient pollution control equipment or device for the purposes of section 19A(1D) of the Act.
